title: Savills APAC Research Publication
description: Single record in /data/publications.json. The array of these records is the canonical source of truth for the publication calendar.

id.description: UUID or slug. Stable unique identifier; generated client-side on add.

country.description: One of the 14 markets plus the regional options Global and Asia Pacific (treated as country-like options).

city_state.description: Free-text city or state/region within the market. May equal the country for city-states.

language.description: One language, or several separated by '; ' (e.g. 'English; Korean') (multi-language allowed 2026-10-20, matching the form check in js/data.js). Each part must be one of the listed languages.

expected_publication_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). null allowed (2026-10-20) only when is_tbd is true; those records show in the TBD panel.

is_tbd.description: OPTIONAL (documented 2026-10-20). True when no publication date is set yet; the platform routes the record to the TBD panel.

lead_author.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-06-18). The named individual who owns/authors the publication, distinct from the broader team. UI tolerates null/missing.

start_date.description: OPTIONAL in JSON, REQUIRED in the master sheet for recurring rows (added 2026-06-18). For recurring series: the ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the series begins. Future instances are projected on/after this date. Null = project from the upload/build date. Backend-only: not surfaced in the detail panel.

recurring_timing_window.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-06-18, v4). For recurring rows whose exact date is not yet known: the within-month timing band used to estimate a placeholder date (Early month -> 5th, Mid-month -> 15th, Late month -> 25th, each snapped to a business day). 'TBD' or null falls back to the last business day of the month.

date_confidence.description: Computed automatically by the build script (v6, 2026-11-06; no owner override). Published & Planned rows with an exact date -> 'Confirmed'; Recurring Timing Window or last-business-day fallback -> 'Estimated'; 'TBD' or no timing -> 'TBD'.

notes.description: OPTIONAL free text. null when the master sheet cell is blank (allowed 2026-10-20).

report_scope.description: Regional reports are the default landing view. In-Country reports are local-market only.

status.description: Issue status from the Published & Planned sheet (v6): published = out; planned = not out yet. Projected instances are 'planned'. Legacy values kept for compatibility.

base_name.description: Base Publication Name from the master workbook (without period). The displayed publication_name is base_name + ' ' + period.

period.description: Period label for the issue, e.g. 'Q3 2026', '1H 2026', 'Nov 2026', '2026'. Null for Ad Hoc.

record_type.description: published = recurring-series issue that is out; planned = recurring-series issue with Status planned (exact date or TBD); adhoc = one-off row from Published & Planned; projected = future instance estimated from the Upcoming Recurring sheet.

published.description: True when the row has Status = published and its date is on or before the build date.

needs_date.description: True when Publication Date is 'TBD' (or 'Date TBC'). Shown in the TBD panel with a 'needs date' tag.

savills_url.description: Link to the issue on Savills.com (optional). The title links to it when present.

source_check.description: Where the Publication Date came from: 'Savills HK listing', 'Savills listing (other site)', 'Not found - manual input needed', or 'Manual'.

planned_date.description: Optional originally planned date (YYYY-MM-DD) from the Published sheet.

recurring.description: True for projected instances of a recurring series.

overdue.description: True when a Published & Planned row has Status = planned and its date has passed (needs review).

allOf.description: A record with no date must be flagged TBD.
